test_name: Configure Test Suite with Detailed Inputs
description: This test validates that a user can configure a test suite by providing all required inputs, including suite name, test type, language, framework, and build tool, and save the configuration successfully.
steps: Navigate to the RoostGPT Config page.
Click the Test Suite tab to open configuration options.
Type a test suite name into the input field.
Select a test type from the dropdown.
Select a programming language from the dropdown.
Select a testing framework from the dropdown.
Select a build tool from the dropdown.
Click the Save button to save the test suite configuration.
Verify that a confirmation message is displayed indicating the test suite was saved successfully.
expected_results: Test suite is saved with the provided configuration.
A confirmation message appears indicating success.
edge_cases: User enters an invalid test suite name (e.g., empty or special characters).
User selects a combination of test type and framework that is incompatible.
User tries to save without selecting a build tool.
User navigates away without saving and loses changes.
User encounters a network failure during the save operation.
data_requirements: Predefined dropdown options for test type.
dependencies: Test Suite tab must be accessible.
Dropdowns must be populated with valid options.
Save button must be enabled only when valid inputs are provided.
performance_metrics: Response time for saving the configuration.
Load time for the Test Suite tab.
accessibility_requirements: All dropdowns must have ARIA roles.
Input fields must have associated labels.
Confirmation message must be screen-reader accessible.
